## Next 34, in build order (30 built, 4 to go)

- Pool: Buildable candidates only.
- Quotas: 15 DEL, 12 Innovation Panel, 10 TESS (UK first; TESS fills topic gaps).
- Order: greedy diversity. Each pick is the candidate whose title sits furthest from everything built and already picked (Voyage title embeddings), discounted for categories we already hold many of; TESS also weighted by its UK priority score.
- Hand rule: DEL experiments whose conditions vary real numbers (Gender aid compared to others, 5 conditions; Gender gap progress, 4) replace 2-condition wording tests, because the title-only measure cannot see design.
- Excluded: pandemic-framed experiments (8 DEL, 1 TESS), ruled out by rich on 10 Oct 2026 as tied to one moment. Two were caught only on reading the instrument: the Apr 2020 aid statement bank and the Apr 2020 "developing countries" split.
- Removed: With God on Our Side (TESS ga53m), ruled out by rich on 10 Oct 2026; later picks moved up one.
- Removed: Ukraine list experiment (DEL Jun2022_list), ruled out by rich on 10 Oct 2026 for a COVID filler statement; later picks moved up one.
- Dropped on build: Measures of wealth (IP 9.5) — no honest single outcome; later picks moved up one.
- Dropped on build: How much punishment fits crimes (TESS pmuag) — no fielded instrument; later picks moved up one.
- Added by rich on 10 Oct 2026: Leadership messages (DEL W3_leadershipsplit), a persuasion experiment, as the last pick.
- Added by rich on 10 Oct 2026: Cost of living (DEL W4_CoLSplit), scheduled next.

## Statuses

- **Built:** Already in the corpus, checked and on disk.
- **Buildable:** Not built. The condition text, the outcome and the record of who saw which condition all appear to exist. Still gets the full check when built.
- **Needs checking:** Not built. Something must be read or found first; the row says what.
- **Unlikely:** Not built. Probably breaks one of our rules (an image condition, no shared outcome, needs US knowledge, no data); the row says which.

**Novelty** (0 to 0.33) is how far a candidate's title sits from the nearest built title. Higher means less like anything we already hold.
